newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Glencore buys Anaconda project stake.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Glencore buys Anaconda project stake.

text.p: Nickel project developer Anaconda Nickel NL said on Friday it had agreed with Swiss commodity trader Glencore International AG that Glencore would take an interest in the Murrin Murrin nickel project of between 30 percent and 49 percent.
"Glencore will spend the sum of US$5.5 million for each one percent interest," Anaconda said.

"Anaconda Nickel NL and Glencore International AG are pleased to announce that an agreement in principle has been reached for Glencore to take up an interest by way of farm-in of between 30 percent and 49 percent in the Murrin Murrin Nickel Cobalt Project," Anaconda said.
Glencore said it was committed to the stage two expansion of the Murrin Murrin project and had also secured rights to participation in and marketing of Anaconda's future projects.
Final details of Glencore's participation in the project would be announced at Anaconda's annual meeting on November 25.
The A$780 million Murrin Murrin nickel project is forecast to produce 100 million pounds of nickel a year once it is fully operational in mid-1998.
Anaconda has said that it could expand the project's annual output to 150 million pounds of nickel and 10 million pounds of cobalt.
It has also said initial estimates indicate this capacity could be in place before the year 2000, registering unit capital costs of around US$3.00 to US$4.00 per pound of nickel produced.
Anaconda's shares were up 25 cents at A$4.60, a new year high, at 3.15 p.m. (0415 GMT). -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
